chapter_path_zh: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划

options.A: 触发器能够实时识别静态数据变化以及基于客户行为的数据变化
options.B: 每年、每三年和每五年定期更新
options.C: 能够根据客户数据而非仅依据时间表来更好地确定优先级
options.D: 将客户分类为不同风险类别

options_en.A: Triggers identifying static data changes and data based on client's behaviors in real time.
options_en.B: Periodic refreshing at one-, three- and five-year cycles.
options_en.C: Ability to prioritize better based on client data rather than driven by schedules alone.
options_en.D: Classification of clients into categories of risk.

raw_question_en: 多选 -[AML/CFT Compliance Programs] Perpetual KYC includes: (Choose two.) A triggers identifying static data changes and data based on client's behaviors in real time. B periodic refreshing at one-, three- and five-year cycles. C ability to prioritize better based on client data rather than driven by schedules alone. D classification of clients into categories of risk.
